components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-jade-600, oklch(58% 0.13 175)); color: oklch(98% 0.005 215); font: 500 0.875rem/1 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-jade-500, oklch(66% 0.14 175)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-jade-500, oklch(66% 0.14 175)); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default button: secondary actions and toolbar controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-ink-800, oklch(21% 0.014 215)); color: var(--color-ink-500, oklch(53% 0.013 215)); font: 500 0.875rem/1 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(21% 0.014 215 / 0.8); color: var(--color-ink-100, oklch(93% 0.008 215)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-jade-500, oklch(66% 0.14 175)); }

components.description: Single-line field; border shifts to jade on focus.

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Mutually exclusive options; the active one is the jade seal.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-seg-opt { padding: 6px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-ink-800, oklch(21% 0.014 215)); color: var(--color-ink-300, oklch(76% 0.011 215)); font: 500 0.75rem/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-seg-opt:hover { background: var(--color-ink-700, oklch(29% 0.015 215)); color: var(--color-ink-100, oklch(93% 0.008 215)); } .ds-seg-opt.is-active { background: var(--color-jade-600, oklch(58% 0.13 175)); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(20% 0.04 175 / 0.4); } .ds-seg-opt:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-jade-500, oklch(66% 0.14 175)); }

components.name: Chip

components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 4px 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(66% 0.14 175 / 0.15); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(66% 0.14 175 / 0.3); color: var(--color-jade-300, oklch(82% 0.11 175)); font: 500 0.75rem/1.4 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip-x { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: oklch(82% 0.11 175 / 0.6); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-x:hover { background: oklch(66% 0.14 175 / 0.2); color: var(--color-jade-300, oklch(82% 0.11 175)); }

narrative.overview:
A dark, quiet room where only the page is lit. Every surface outside the artwork is furniture: cool, low, and still, so the eye settles on covers in the library and on the page in the reader. The chrome exists to be stopped noticing; within a minute of reading it should have dissolved into the dark.

The world is built from two materials. Sumi Ink, a cool 215° tinted neutral that is never pure gray, makes up every surface, border, and line of text. Seal Jade, a 175° teal, is the lamp: it marks the one thing that is active, selected, or ready to act, and appears nowhere else. Type pairs a book serif (Newsreader, pinned to its display optical size) for titles with a precise humanist sans (Hanken Grotesk) for all interface text, so titles read like a spine on a shelf and controls read like a native desktop tool.

Density is comfortable but not airy. The manga grid is the densest surface; toolbars and menus are spaced for confident mouse use without feeling like a mobile app. Motion is short (200ms or less) and only reports a change of state. It must feel like a native desktop app, never a website in a window, and it explicitly rejects generic Material/Bootstrap dashboards, Calibre-style cluttered toolbars, and kawaii anime styling (pastel gradients, mascots, sparkles, rounded-everything).
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only today; semantic tokens sit on top of the scales so a light theme can be layered under `[data-theme="light"]` without touching dark.
One accent, used sparingly: Seal Jade marks state, never decoration.
Flat tonal layering at rest; shadows only for floating layers and state.
Serif titles, sans everything else, tabular numerals for counts; mono only for paths.
lucide-solid line icons only; no emoji, no illustration.
Short, direction-aware motion; shimmer skeletons for loading.

rules.name: The Single Lamp Rule
rules.body: Seal Jade marks what is active, selected, or the one primary action, and nothing else. No jade borders at rest, no jade headings, no jade decoration. If two jade fills compete in one view, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Tinted Ink Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is an `ink-*` step. Never stock `zinc`, `gray`, `slate`, or `neutral`, and never a pure `#000`-derived gray for a surface. Black and white appear only as overlays and scrims on top of cover artwork, where they need to read against arbitrary images.

rules.name: The Spine Rule
rules.body: Newsreader names things: a view's subject, a settings section, a dialog. It never labels a control, a button, a menu item, or metadata.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: UI text lives at 500 (medium) for anything interactive or titled and 400 for supporting text. Semibold is for small headings in menus and toolbars; bold is effectively unused.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No card, panel, or button carries a shadow in its resting state. If a resting surface needs separation, step its ink tone or add an `ink-*` border.

dos: **Do** build every surface from `ink-*` steps: `ink-950` floor, `ink-900` panel, `ink-800` control, `ink-700` border.
**Do** reserve Seal Jade (`jade-600` fill, `jade-500` ring/indicator, `jade-400` text) for active, selected, focused, or the single primary action.
**Do** use Newsreader only for view titles, settings sections, and dialog titles; everything else is Hanken Grotesk.
**Do** keep motion at 200ms or less, ease-out, and only to report a change of state (page turn, open, select, hover lift).
**Do** use `tabular-nums` for every count and page number.
**Do** use lucide-solid icons at 16–18px in toolbars and the rail, 12–14px on cover overlays.
**Do** show focus with a 2px Lit Jade `:focus-visible` ring or a jade border shift on inputs.
donts: **Don't** use stock Tailwind neutrals or accents (`zinc`, `gray`, `slate`, `indigo`, `blue`); red is the only stock scale permitted, and only for destructive or error states.
**Don't** put shadows on resting cards, panels, or buttons; Float is for floating layers, Lift is for hover.
**Don't** introduce a second accent color, gradients on chrome, or decorative glows.
**Don't** use web idioms: hero sections, marketing cards, CTA banners, link-blue underlines, breadcrumb chevrons.
**Don't** use emoji, mascots, sparkles, pastel gradients, or pill-shaped everything.
**Don't** add bouncy springs, parallax, or motion that performs rather than informs.
**Don't** place anything over the reader page that isn't summoned by the user.
